method: Apply this delta on top of the single-prefill experiment, in place of the earlier ready8-only delta. FLASH_VERIFY_MIN_READY gates only four-position verification in the Flash Next 8 GiB experiment. An underfilled final demand wave waits for its remaining experts. Independent fresh single-slot Metal servers per run, run sequentially. Context and logical batch 4096, target microbatch 8, compact DFlash2 depth 3 and draft microbatch 128. Identical 8/8 warmup, greedy seed 42, uncached 912-ID prompt and 64 real streamed IDs. Clean order 8-16-16-8; pool 126 post-first-token intervals per threshold. Separate expert-counter diagnostic runs in order 16-8. Counts refer to timed expert Metal submissions across 24 verification batches. Diagnostic times divided by the same 63 post-first token intervals. Kernel command duration overlaps host time. OS file cache and thermals uncontrolled.
